2608.07251.title: Reading Copom's Tone: A Weighted LLM Framework for Hawkish-Dovish Sentiment, Forward Guidance, and Uncertainty
2608.07251.paper_summary: This paper documents an applied natural-language-processing framework for measuring the tone of Brazilian Monetary Policy Committee (Copom) statements. The project is explicitly inspired by iSent, Itaú's Central Bank sentiment classifier, particularly its sentence-level division of official communication into hawkish, dovish, neutral, and out-of-context classes. The implementation extends that idea in three directions. First, an LLM identifies short hawkish and dovish expressions and assigns each a 0-to-1 intensity weight. Second, the document index combines sentence counts with document-specific average signal intensities, producing a bounded score from -1 to 1. Third, a separate full-document layer measures forward-guidance direction, guidance explicitness, uncertainty level, and change in uncertainty. The empirical sample is restricted to communications dated August 2016 or later and contains 80 statements and 1,498 classified sentences from August 31, 2016 through August 5, 2026. Across this sample, 33.3% of sentences are hawkish, 18.0% dovish, 42.1% neutral, and 6.5% out of context. The average document score is +0.107, while the most hawkish reading is +0.570 in August 2021. The latest statement, dated August 5, 2026, scores +0.232, with eight hawkish, two dovish, and nine neutral sentences. Its structural overlay is more nuanced: guidance is directionally ambiguous but partly explicit, while uncertainty is classified as central and higher than at the prior meeting. Tone and the guidance-direction score have a contemporaneous Pearson correlation of 0.719. These are descriptive outputs, not a validated forecast of Selic decisions or DI returns. The main contribution is therefore methodological: a transparent, incremental, auditable system that separates rhetorical tone from policy guidance and uncertainty.
2608.07251.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文記錄了一個應用自然語言處理的框架，用於衡量巴西貨幣政策委員會（Copom）聲明的語氣。該項目明確受到iSent的啟發，iSent是伊塔烏中央銀行的情感分類器，特別是其對官方通訊的句子級別劃分為鷹派、鴿派、中立和脫離上下文類別。這一實施在三個方向上擴展了這一想法。首先，一個大型語言模型識別短小的鷹派和鴿派表達，並為每個表達分配0到1的強度權重。其次，文檔索引將句子數量與文檔特定的平均信號強度結合，生成一個範圍從-1到1的分數。第三，單獨的全文層測量前瞻性指引方向、指引明確性、不確定性水平和不確定性的變化。實證樣本限制在2016年8月或以後的通訊，包含80份聲明和從2016年8月31日到2026年8月5日的1,498句分類句子。在這個樣本中，33.3%的句子是鷹派，18.0%是鴿派，42.1%是中立，6.5%是脫離上下文。平均文檔分數為+0.107，而最鷹派的讀數為2021年8月的+0.570。最新的聲明日期為2026年8月5日，得分為+0.232，其中包含八個鷹派、兩個鴿派和九個中立句子。其結構性覆蓋更為微妙：指引在方向上模糊但部分明確，而不確定性被分類為中心且高於上次會議的水平。語氣和指引方向分數之間的當期Pearson相關性為0.719。這些是描述性輸出，而不是對Selic決策或DI回報的有效預測。因此，主要貢獻在於方法論：一個透明、漸進、可審計的系統，將修辭語氣與政策指引和不確定性分開。
2608.07251.author: Gabriel de Macedo Santos et.al.
